value.signature: fn decode_account (input : Option < & [u8] > , selected_edition : u64 , limits : & ReadAllowances ,) -> Result < AuthorityAccount , FragmentError >

review.body: { if selected_edition != 1 { return Err (FragmentError :: UnsupportedEdition) ; } let input = input . ok_or (FragmentError :: MissingComponent) ? ; if input . len () > limits . encoded_bytes || input . len () > limits . account_bytes { return Err (FragmentError :: UnavailableBudget) ; } let value = Value :: from_canonical_bytes (input) . map_err (| _ | FragmentError :: Canonical) ? ; parse_account (& value , limits) }
review.item_premise: Caller-selected fragment codecs read complete public component bytes under supplied limits and return bounded public refusals. They neither select an evaluator nor establish publication binding.
